reason: CH43-S01 establishes the regulatory requirement for risk-based onboarding; CH43-S02 later applies that foundation by detailing QC objectives that ensure adherence to those regulations.
CH43-S01 introduces the need for risk-based onboarding controls; CH43-S02 later applies that foundation by recommending measures to enhance QC effectiveness in maintaining those controls.

CH44-S01 introduces ongoing due diligence and periodic KYC reviews as a foundation; CH44-S02 later applies that foundation to PEP screening program considerations, including when to screen and ongoing rescreening.

CH44-S01 defines batch screening and its purposes (identifying emerging risks, regulatory compliance, preventing financial crime); CH44-S02 later applies those same purposes to adverse media screening objectives.

CH44-S01 introduces batch screening's structured process including false positive resolution and escalation; CH44-S02 later applies similar evaluation criteria (credibility, relevance, timeframe) to adverse media findings.
